bounded_slice.finding: The pinned test cargo_compile_with_downloaded_dependency_with_offline first performs an online cargo check for present_dep 1.2.3, making the dependency locally available, and a second project using the same registry dependency then succeeds with cargo check --offline. In the same pinned file, offline_missing_optional deliberately does not download opt_dep during the first check; offline succeeds while that optional dependency is unused, but enabling it offline fails at the download stage. Within this exact test scope, successful offline use of an actually needed registry dependency therefore requires locally resolvable registry/index metadata plus the dependency payload/source already available locally. Metadata alone can resolve the package but cannot supply a missing crate payload.
bounded_slice.verified_scope: Only the two pinned Cargo tests cargo_compile_with_downloaded_dependency_with_offline and offline_missing_optional in tests/testsuite/offline.rs at commit 8814ead110e36ed8fdcf1fdd4009baf82bd78523, interpreted as stage-discriminating evidence for registry dependencies.
bounded_slice.not_verified_scope: No claim is made for all Cargo versions, git/path dependencies, lockfile-only resolution, vendored source replacement, arbitrary cache layouts, real crates.io state, Chat-native cache population, or actual Cargo execution inside Chat.

minimum_local_state_in_scope.registry_index_or_equivalent_resolution_: required to select/resolve the needed registry package in the tested path
minimum_local_state_in_scope.crate_payload_or_equivalent_local_source: required when the resolved package must actually be loaded/built; a missing payload causes offline download failure
minimum_local_state_in_scope.network_access: not required after both tested prerequisites are local

scope_guard: Do not generalize these tests into a claim that every offline Cargo operation always requires a registry index or that vendoring/lockfiles cannot alter the prerequisite set. The supported conclusion is limited to the pinned registry-dependency tests above.

hard_gate_assessment.positive_evidence_scope: Official source-level prerequisite classification only; no end-to-end Chat parity claim.
